title: Detailed crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='orbGrad' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f8ff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='35%' stop-color='#a8d8f0' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#5b8fc7' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a4a7a' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='innerGlow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='45%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8e8ff' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#6aa8dd' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a6aaa' stop-opacity='0.1'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='baseGrad' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8c84a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#c89828'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a6418'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='baseTop' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0d860'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b89020'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='mistGrad' cx='50%' cy='60%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d0eaff' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7ab0d8' stop-opacity='0.1'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Base shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#3a5a8a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Ornate golden base -->
  <path d='M28 82 Q28 78 31 76 L31 72 Q50 66 69 72 L69 76 Q72 78 72 82 Z' fill='url(#baseGrad)' stroke='#d4a830' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <path d='M32 72 Q50 67 68 72' fill='none' stroke='#f8e080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='19' ry='4' fill='url(#baseTop)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#b89020'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='22' ry='5' fill='none' stroke='#e8c84a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M30 76 Q50 71 70 76' fill='none' stroke='#f0d860' stroke-width='0.7'/>

  <!-- Base decorative dots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='79' r='1.5' fill='#f8e8a0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#f8e8a0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='79' r='1.5' fill='#f8e8a0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='81' r='1' fill='#f8e8a0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='81' r='1' fill='#f8e8a0'/>

  <!-- Base prongs holding crystal -->
  <path d='M33 72 Q32 65 35 60' fill='none' stroke='#d4a830' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 72 Q68 65 65 60' fill='none' stroke='#d4a830' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 72 L50 66' fill='none' stroke='#d4a830' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Crystal ball main sphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='url(#orbGrad)' stroke='#7aaad8' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Inner glow / mystical cloud -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='18' fill='url(#innerGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='40' rx='12' ry='8' fill='url(#mistGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='48' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#c8e4ff' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Mystical swirling shapes inside -->
  <path d='M40 38 Q44 32 50 34 Q56 36 55 42 Q54 48 48 46 Q42 44 40 38Z' fill='#e0f0ff' opacity='0.45'/>
  <path d='M46 44 Q50 40 55 43 Q58 48 54 51 Q48 54 46 44Z' fill='#d8ecff' opacity='0.35'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#f0f8ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#f0f8ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Small sparkling stars inside -->
  <path d='M42 50 L43 48 L44 50 L43 52Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M57 36 L58 34.5 L59 36 L58 37.5Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M48 55 L49 53.5 L50 55 L49 56.5Z' fill='#e8f4ff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Highlight reflection on crystal surface -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='30' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(-25 40 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='33' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-25 38 33)'/>

  <!-- Secondary smaller highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8f4ff' opacity='0.25' transform='rotate(30 63 52)'/>

  <!-- Bottom reflection -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='64' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#a0c8f0' opacity='0.2'/>
</svg>
